LicenseRef-LLVM-Third-Party identifies the verbatim texts and copyright notices
in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt, mapped to their authenticated upstream source files
by SOURCE.json. It supplements the LLVM Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception and
Polly/ISL/imath notices installed beside this directory. It is not a new license
grant or a claim that every upstream file has the same license.

The collection includes the xxHash BSD notice, Unicode conversion/data notices,
OpenBSD/Henry Spencer regex notices and BLAKE3 license, as well as individual
copyright notices from the LLVM and Polly library/header sources. Some retained
notices cover upstream material that is not linked into these packages.
